what: The default cursor is hidden and an 8px glowing dot (text color, 10px glow around it) follows the mouse by 28% each frame. Past positions are stamped every time it moves more than 1.5px and remembered for only 150ms, and a ribbon joining them tapers from 9px at the head to 1.5px at the tail, with the tail end fading out (10px glow). Over links and buttons the dot grows in .3s into a 40px empty ring (1px border). When the mouse leaves the window it turns off in .3s

options.lerp: Share the dot follows per frame, default .28
options.width · min: Extra width toward the tail head · end width (px), default 7.5 · 1.5
options.--fx-size · --fx-hover-size: Dot size · size of the ring above the link (css), default 8px · 40px

note: Attached only on mouse (hover: hover, pointer: fine). On touch or reduced motion it does nothing and the default cursor stays. Over links, buttons, [data-cursor], label and summary it is treated as a ring

from.where: index.html .id-cursor (original custom-cursor — dot head + canvas tail)
